$comment: Forge is single-profile by design: one engineer profile enabling the core loop (forge/implementer/reviewer) plus the lazy escalation agents (architect, sme-*). The lazy agents are installed but only invoked conditionally by the gate, so token cost stays on-demand.

engineer.title: Staff Engineer
engineer.description: Code delivery at a staff-engineer bar: bounded implement -> review -> refine, with lazy architect/SME escalation.
